lg.l:
jalāṃ copajalāṃ caiva yamunām abhito na
dīṃ ||
uśīnaro vai yatreṣṭvā vāsavād atyaricyata ||
tāṃ devasamitiṃ tasya vāsavaś ca viśām pate ||
abhyagachan nṛpavaraṃ jñātum agniś ca bhārata ||

jijñāsamānau varadau mahātmāna
m uśīnaraṃ ||
iṃdraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto 'gnir bhūtvā yajñe 'bhijagmatuḥ ||
ūruṃ rājñaḥ samāsādya kapotaḥ śyenajād bhayāt ||
śaraṇārthī tadā rājan nililye bhayapīḍitaḥ ||
dharmātmānaṃ tv āhur ekaṃ sarve rājan mahīkṣitaḥ ||
sa vai dharmavirurddhaṃ tvaṃ kasmāt karma cikīrṣasi ||

vihitaṃ
bhakṣaṇaṃ rājan_ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā ||
mā rakṣīr dharmmalobhena dharmam utsṛṣṭavān asi ||
|| saṃtrastarūpas trāṇāya tvatto bhīto mahādvijaḥ ||
matsakāśam anuprāptaḥ prāṇagṛdhnur ayaṃ dvijaḥ ||
evam abhyāgatasyeha kapotasyābhayārthinaḥ ||
atra dāne paraṃ dharmaṃ kathaṃ syena na paśyasi ||

praspaṃdamānaḥ saṃbhrāṃtaḥ
kapotaḥ śyena lakṣyate ||
matsakāśaṃ jiīvitārthatasya tyāgo vigarhitaḥ ||
yo hi kaści dvijān hanyād gāṃ vā lokasya mātaraṃ ||

śaraṇāgataṃ ca tyajate tulyaṃ
teṣāṃ hi pātakaṃ ||
|| āhārāt sarvabhūtāni saṃbhavaṃti mahīpate ||
āhāreṇa vivarddhaṃte tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ ||

śakyate dustyaje py arthe cira
rātrāya jīvituṃ ||
na tu bhojanam utsṛjya śakyaṃ varttayituṃ ciraṃ ||
bhakṣyād vijojitasyādya mama prāṇā viśām pate ||

visṛjya kāyam eṣyaṃtīṣa sthānam akuto
bhayaṃ ||
pramṛte mayi dharmātman_ putradāraṃ vinakṣyati ||
rakṣyamānaḥ kapotaṃ tvaṃ bahūn prāṇān na rakṣasi ||
dharmmaṃ yo bādhate dharmmo na sa dharmaḥ kudharma tat ||

a
virodhī tu yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ satyavikramaḥ ||
virodhiṣu mahīpāla niścitya gurulāghavaṃ ||
na bādhā vidyate yatra taṃ dharmaṃ samudācara ||

gurulāghavam ā
dāya dharmādharmādharmaviniścaye ||
yato bhūyāṃs tato rājan_ kuru adharmaniścayaṃ ||
|| bahukalyāṇasaṃyuktaṃ bhāṣase vihagottama ||

su
parṇaḥ pakṣirāṭ_ kiṃ tvaṃ dharmaṃjñaś cāsyasaṃśayaṃ ||
tathā hi dharmasaṃyuktaṃ bahu citraṃ ca bhāṣase ||
na te sty aviditaṃ kiṃcid iti tvāṃ lakṣayāmy ahaṃ ||
śaraṇaiṣi parityāgaṃ kathaṃ sādhvīti manyase ||
āhārārthaṃ samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgama ||
śakyaś cāpy anyathā karttuṃ āhāro bhyadhikas tvayā ||
govṛṣo vā varāho vā mṛgo vā mahiṣo pi vā ||
tvadartham adya kriyatāṃ yac cānyad abhikāṃkṣasi ||

|| na varāhaṃ na cokṣāṇaṃ na mṛ
gāṃ vividhāṃs tathā ||
bhakṣayāmi mahārāja kim mamānye na kenacit ||
yas tu me daivavihito bhakṣaḥ kṣatriyapuṃgava ||

tam utsṛja mahīpāla kapo
tam imam eva me ||
śyenaḥ kapotān attīti sthitir eṣā sanātanī ||
mā rājan sārany ajñātvā kadalīstaṃbham āvraja ||

|| rājyaṃ śivīnā
m ṛddhaṃ vai dadāni tava khecara ||
yaṃ ca kāmayase kāmaṃ śena sarvaṃ dadāmi te ||
vinemaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ śena śaraṇārthinam āgataṃ ||

yenemaṃ varjjayes tvaṃ ka
rmaṇā pakṣisattama ||
tadācakṣva kariṣyāmi na hi dāsye kapotakaṃ ||
uśīnara kapote te yadi sneho narādhipa ||

ā
tmano māṃsam utkṛtya kapotatulayā dhṛtaṃ ||
yadā samaṃ kapotena tava māṃśaṃ nṛpottama ||
tadā deyaṃ tu tan mahyaṃ sā me tuṣṭir bhaviṣyati ||
anugraham imaṃ manye śyena yan mābhibhāṣase ||
tasmāt te 'dya pradāsyāmi svamāṃśaṃ tulayā dhṛtaṃ ||

|| utkṛtya
sa svakaṃ māṃsaṃ rājā paramadharmavīt ||
tulayāmāsa kauṃteya kapotena samaṃ vibho ||
dhṛyamānaḥ kapotaṃ tu māṃsenātyatiricyate ||

punaś cotkṛ
tya māṃsāni rājā prādād uśīnaraḥ ||
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ dhṛtaṃ ||
tata utkṛtyamāṃsaṃ sa āruroha svayaṃ tulāṃ ||

||
idro 'ham asmi dharmajña kapoto havyavāḍ ayaṃ ||
jijñāsamānau dharme tvāṃ yajñavāṭam upāgatau ||

yat te māṃsāni gātrebhya uttkṛttāni viśāṃ
pate ||
eṣā te bhāsurī kīrttir lokān abhibhaviṣyati ||
yāval loke manuṣyās tvāṃ kathayiṣyaṃti pārthiva ||

tāvat kīrttiś ca lokāś ca
sthāsyanti tava śāśvatāḥ ||
ity evam uktvā rājānam āruroha divaṃ punaḥ ||
uśīnaro pi dharmātmā dharmeṇāvṛtya rodasī ||
vibhrājamāno vapuṣā āruroha tripiṣṭapaṃ ||
tad etat sadanaṃ rājan_ rājñas tasya mahātmanaḥ ||
paśyaś caitan mayā sārddhaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpapramocanaṃ ||

tatra
vai satataṃ devā munayaś ca sanātanāḥ ||
dṛśyante brāhmaṇai rājan_ puṇyarvādbhar mahātmabhiḥ ||

body.p: || ity āraṇyake parvaṇi tīrthayātrāyā kapotīyaṃ samāptaṃ || || ||
